scope: 111 new appearances for waves102–202; existing articulated limbs retained, new isolated three-view bodies. No ready state implied by this design catalog.

entries.name: 왕관 운반다람쥐
entries.design: small rodent with a bronze crown-shaped backpack and rolled parchment
entries.materials: aged bronze, mossy stone accents, warm teal cloth
entries.originalDesign: A small adventurous rat with intact charcoal fur, a rounded compact body, alert expressive eyes, a leather collar and exactly one simple curved tail. Four sturdy little paws, a curious determined face and a clean game-character silhouette.
